fixed_statement:
Assumptions / Conditions / Definitions.
- Let \(1/3<p<1/2\).
- Take \(m=3\), \(w_1=w_2=w_3=1/3\), and \(K=v_1+v_2+v_3\).

Statement :
\[
\mathbb P\!\left(\frac K3\ge p\right)
=
p^2(3-2p).
\]
fixed_proof:
By Lemma 6.1, the event \(\frac K3\ge p\) is the event \(K\ge2\). Since \(K\sim\Bin(3,p)\), its probability is
\[
\mathbb P\!\left(\frac K3\ge p\right)
=
\mathbb P(K\ge2)
=
3p^2(1-p)+p^3
=
p^2(3-2p).
\]
